mapper.sql: select cd.data_id, cd.template_id, ct.template_name, ct.template_code, cd.biz_status, cd.dept_id, cd.data_code, cd.version, cd.submit_by, cd.submit_time, cd.remark, cd.del_flag, cd.create_by, cd.create_time, cd.update_by, cd.update_time from collect_data cd left join collect_template ct on ct.template_id = cd.template_id
mapper.select: select cd.data_id, cd.template_id, ct.template_name, ct.template_code, cd.form_data, cd.biz_status, cd.dept_id, cd.data_code, cd.version, cd.submit_by, cd.submit_time, cd.remark, cd.del_flag, cd.create_by, cd.create_time, cd.update_by, cd.update_time from collect_data cd left join collect_template ct on ct.template_id = cd.template_id where cd.data_id = #{dataId} and cd.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into collect_data (data_id, template_id, form_data, biz_status, dept_id, data_code, version, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, submit_by) values (#{dataId}, #{templateId}, #{formData}, #{bizStatus}, #{deptId}, #{dataCode}, #{version}, #{remark}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{submitBy})
mapper.update: update collect_data set del_flag = '2' where data_id = #{dataId} and biz_status = 'draft' and del_flag = '0'
update collect_data set del_flag = '2' where biz_status = 'draft' and del_flag = '0' and data_id in #{dataId}
